preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if a valid permutation of the string s exists that satisfies the given conditions.
The output is 'NO' if no valid permutation of the string s exists that satisfies the given conditions.
If the output is 'YES', then the output_string is a permutation of the input string s.
